comments.body:
🚨 severity: BLOCKING —
🚨 **BLOCKING: the missing-data exit clears the carrier from the ticket only — the PR side stays stuck and starves the review loop**

`handleMissingReviewData` removes `ai_reviewing` from the ticket but never from the PR (the in-code comment defers the PR side to "the follow-up staleness sweep" — which does not exist: not in this diff, not in the ticket's follow-ups list). Every review arming rule reads **both** carriers: `review-after-dev` / `review-on-issue-label` check `notPrLabels: [ai_reviewing]` on the linked PR (`sm_github.json:610-620`, `sm_github.json:667-672`), and the PR-anchored rules check it on `notLabels` too.

So after the **handled** missing-output exit (a real, exercised path — it has its own resume logic at `readOrResumeReviewData`), the PR keeps `ai_reviewing` forever → every re-arm skips → the PR/issue is starved from review until a human removes the label. The naked-PR sweep cannot heal it either — this PR deliberately added the carrier to `LIFECYCLE_LABELS` (`js/common/nakedPrReconcile.js:31`), so a PR mid-carrier is never "naked". The PR description's claim "the world returns to 'review wanted, not running'" is only true for the ticket anchor; the PR anchor stays "running" permanently.

**Fix**: at this exit, resolve the PR (the branch/PR context is available via `params` / the input folder the pre-action wrote; `ctx.scm` is already built in `buildReviewContext`) and clear both sides — ideally by routing through the same `clearReviewInProgressCarrier` the verdict path uses.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
🚨 severity: BLOCKING —
🚨 **BLOCKING: a leg that dies between the stamp and its post-action wedges both anchors permanently — no staleness recovery exists**

The stamp is intentionally placed before the slow steps (checkout/diff) to shrink the race window — good. But the PR's own characterization test pins that the failure path **keeps** the carrier: *"the failure path keeps it — cleanup is the verdict path's job"* (`js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview.js:939-952`, the `git exploded` mid-flow setup-error case). A leg that dies after the stamp never reaches its post-action: no verdict path runs and `handleMissingReviewData` never runs.

Net effect with this change: all five arming rules skip on the carrier (both anchors), the naked-PR sweep refuses to re-arm under it (`ai_reviewing` in `LIFECYCLE_LABELS`), and **no SM-side staleness/liveness probe exists for `ai_reviewing`** — unlike its twin `ai_validating`, which has removal probes in `js/sm/mergeAndParkProbes.js:83,105,320`, `js/sm/prVerdictAndSweepActions.js:27` and `js/sm/prLifecycleActions.js:266`. Checkout failures (the recurring dead-head class with its own subsystems: gh-922 no-ref bookeeping, fork parks), API flakes and CLI crashes previously converted into "retried next tick until recovered/parked" — the dead-letter recovery the SM configs document as *"the dead-letter recovery the machine loop is built on"* (`sm_github.json` rework-on-red-ci description). The carrier defeats that recovery, and the park counters can no longer accumulate because re-dispatch never happens.

**Fix** (either): (a) an SM-side staleness probe that clears `ai_reviewing` when no active `ai-teammate` run exists on the branch (`ai_validating` parity), or (b) clear the carrier on non-verdict leg exits in the runner's failure path.

The new function added by this PR breaches the CRAP ≤ 8 ratchet (multiple `try/catch` + conditional branches, partial coverage). Per the repo's ratchet ("CRAP may only decrease"), this fails the gate.

**Fix**: extract the linked-issue stamp half into a helper (e.g. `stampLinkedIssueCarrier(ctx, prDetails)`) — this simplifies both halves and also relieves the module-size pin breach on this same file (42 top-level functions > max 40) — or add coverage until CRAP ≤ 8.

🚨 severity: BLOCKING —
🚨 **BLOCKING: `crap` CI check red — module-size pins breached on both touched modules**

CI on commit `3d2ad85a` (module-size step, exit 2):

```
js/postPRReviewComments.js: grew above pin: 3433 lines > max 3382, 274 top-level functions > max 272
js/preparePRForReview.js: 42 top-level functions > max 40
```

Verified locally against `origin/main`: `postPRReviewComments.js` was **exactly at its pin** (3382 lines / 272 functions) and this PR's +51 lines / +2 functions pushed it over; `preparePRForReview.js` was exactly at 40 top-level functions and this PR's `branchLinkedIssueNumber` + `markReviewInProgress` pushed it to 42. Both breaches are fully attributable to this change.

**Fix**: extract the gh-1540 carrier helpers (stamp + clear + the branch→issue parse) into a small shared module (e.g. `js/common/reviewCarrier.js`). That brings both modules back under their pins and also dedups the gh-branch regex now copy-pasted in three places (`js/preparePRForReview.js:268`, `js/postPRReviewComments.js:2620`, `js/pushReworkChanges.js:210` — plus a laxer variant in `js/mergeTrigger.js:117`).

## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The gh-1540 design (label carrier `ai_reviewing` + in-tick dispatch latch + per-branch concurrency) is sound and well tested — I re-ran the PR's own verification suites locally (`run_smAgent.json` 869 ✓, `run_postPRReviewComments.json` 225 ✓, `run_preparePRForReview.json` 65 ✓, matching CI's 11120-pass suite run); AC1/AC2/AC4/AC5 are demonstrated. It is blocked by a carrier with **no recovery path** and a **red `crap` CI check** (both owned by this PR); ticket AC3 is only partially met (carrier absence guaranteed on verdict exits, not failure exits). The `$f` CI lines are foreign parser noise per `ci_classification.json` — not chased.

**Key Issues**:
1. 🚨 `js/postPRReviewComments.js:351` — missing-data exit clears only the ticket carrier; the PR side stays stuck and every arming rule skips forever (`notPrLabels` reads the linked PR).
2. 🚨 `js/preparePRForReview.js:621` — stamp-then-die legs (checkout failure, API flake — pinned by this PR's own test) keep the carrier on both anchors; no staleness probe exists (`ai_validating` has three).
3. 🚨 `js/preparePRForReview.js:282` — CRAP ratchet red: new function CRAP 9 > 8 (exit 2).
4. 🚨 `js/postPRReviewComments.js:2682` — module-size pins red on both touched modules (3433>3382 lines & 274>272 funcs; 42>40 funcs — both exactly at pin on `main`).
5. ⚠️ `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml:112` — per-ref group globally serializes unrelated default-ref legs (fork reroutes, `review-external-once`, `dev-on-assignment`) and drops event-vs-dispatch same-issue serialization.

**Next Steps**:
1. Clear the PR-side carrier on the missing-data exit (route through `clearReviewInProgressCarrier`) and add an SM-side staleness probe / failure-path clear — `ai_validating` parity.
2. Extract the gh-1540 carrier helpers into a shared `js/common/*` module — fixes both module pins, the CRAP ratchet, and dedups the triplicated branch→issue regex.
3. Key the dispatch group on the item branch (`inputs.branch`) so same-head lanes still serialize but unrelated legs keep their own groups; pin "unrelated PRs do not share a group" in the template test.
